Class_Skill_Desc_Blazing Spellblade: Delivers an attack with a potency of 200.</br>Honed Spellblade Potency: 300</br>Potency scales with item level.</br>Additional Effect: Increases target's damage taken by 5%</br>Duration: 70s</br>Additional Effect: Increases damage dealt by 5%</br>Duration: 70s</br>Shares a recast timer with Sundering Spellblade and Holy Spellblade.
Class_Skill_Desc_Holy Spellblade: Delivers an attack with a potency of 300.</br>Potency increases to 500 when used against undead enemies.</br>Honed Spellblade Potency: 400</br>Spellblade potency increases to 600 when used against undead enemies.</br>Potency scales with item level.</br>Shares a recast timer with Sundering Spellblade and Blazing Spellblade.
Class_Skill_Desc_Magic Shell: Creates a barrier around self or target party member that absorbs damage equivalent to 20% of the caster's maximum HP.</br>Duration: 60s</br>When the barrier is completely absorbed or expires, grants Honed Spellblade to the caster.</br>Honed Spellblade Effect: Increases damage dealt by next Spellblade</br>Duration: 30s
Class_Skill_Desc_Sundering Spellblade: Delivers an attack with a potency of 200.</br>Honed Spellblade Potency: 300</br>Potency scales with item level.</br>Additional Effect: 20% chance to Petrify target</br>Petrify Effect: Incapacitated upon taking damage</br>Duration: 10s</br>Shares a recast timer with Holy Spellblade and Blazing Spellblade.
